title: Evenness of symmetric average length
statement: For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, real numbers $a,b,t,c$, and vectors $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, the symmetric average length satisfies $L(-t,c)=L(t,c)$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a real-valued function on the reals
replaced: For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. For all parameters, $L(-t,c)=L(t,c)$.
